## Evaluation

```python
def <B50>(x):
    return <V50>

assert <B50>(147) == <V50>
assert <B50>(-86) == <V50>
```

When invoked with 270, <B50> evaluates to <V50>. Similarly, <B50>(918) yields <V50>.
The <B50> function is a constant integer function with fixed return value <V50>.
